title: AIVV Canonical Envelope
description: Schema for the canonical envelope emitted by view-loader.sh --json (schema_version: 2). Covers Phase 0 loader output plus v1a additive investigation-surface properties.

review_id.description: The review identifier from the source file, e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS-<suffix>'. Null when the source file has no top-level review_id.

review_meta.description: Top-level review metadata projected from the source file.

lens.description: Lens(es) used for this review, e.g. 'code', 'ux,visual'.

reviewers.description: Number of reviewers as a string or integer, e.g. '2'. Null when absent in source.

invoked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was invoked.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review completed.

status.description: Terminal status of the review, e.g. 'complete', 'partial'.

provider_trust.description: Provider trust posture for provider-backed review logs. Null for historical local/native reviews.

review_scope.description: Optional persisted audit context describing the reviewed subject and explicit scope boundaries.

plan_review.description: Optional persisted provenance for forward-looking /aivv --plan reviews.

review_prompt_profile.description: Optional persisted reviewer prompt metadata. Raw full prompts may be omitted or redacted.

reviewer_evidence_packet.description: Optional persisted reviewer evidence packet metadata, hash, and redacted/omitted content marker.

reviewer_roster.description: Optional roster of reviewer dispatch attempts and outcomes.

findings.description: Array of projected findings, one per source finding object.

loader_warnings.description: Structured warnings emitted during projection. See loader-warnings.md for taxonomy.

lifecycle.description: Read-only lifecycle projection joined from sibling AIVV lifecycle state.

lifecycle_incident.description: Viewer-facing incident summary projected from .aivv/state/incidents records.

lifecycle_problem.description: Viewer-facing problem-cluster summary projected from .aivv/state/problems records.

lifecycle_issue.description: Viewer-facing local issue summary projected from .aivv/state/issues records.

finding.description: Single projected finding in canonical form.

id.description: Projected from `ref` (priority) then `id`. Null when neither present. Note: real-corpus `ref` values appear in two forms — slug-form (e.g. 'F1-iconography-xref-drift') and base-form (e.g. 'F001'). Fix-log `findings_addressed[]` entries use base/zero-padded forms (e.g. 'F1', 'F001'). The loader normalizes both sides (slug-strip + zero-pad) when resolving `resolution.addressed`; the raw projected id preserves the source value.

severity.description: Severity level. Projected directly; default 'MINOR' fires field_default_applied warning. Both upper- and lower-case appear in the historical corpus.

impact_tier.description: legacy-schema compatibility rules impact axis emitted by impact_likelihood reviews, e.g. CATASTROPHIC, SEVERE, MODERATE, or NEGLIGIBLE. Null for legacy reviews and findings that do not emit the axis.

likelihood.description: legacy-schema compatibility rules likelihood axis emitted by impact_likelihood reviews, e.g. CERTAIN, PROBABLE, POSSIBLE, or UNLIKELY. Null for legacy reviews and findings that do not emit the axis.

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence, e.g. 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Null in pre-dev.41 shapes.

category.description: Finding category string, e.g. 'correctness', 'drift'. Null in many shapes.

summary.description: Human-readable finding text. Projected from `description` (priority), then `summary`, then `title`, then empty string.

title.description: Short title distinct from summary. Preserved when both `title` and `summary`/`description` present in source.

file.description: Source file path the finding refers to. Projected from `file` string; for dev.6 shapes projected from `files[0]`. Null when absent.

scope_ref.description: Non-file finding location. Present for modern process/session/artifact/project findings; null for file-backed and legacy findings.

location_label.description: Deterministic display location: file path for file-backed findings, or '<scope_ref.kind>:<scope_ref.ref>' for scoped findings.

line.description: Line number within `file`. Null when absent in source.

reviewer.description: Reviewer identifier (e.g. 'Alpha', 'Beta'). NOT synthesized — null pass-through when absent.

lens.description: Lens for this specific finding. Projected from finding's own `lens`, then top-level `lens`. Null when neither present.

rule_id.description: Standards rule identifier projected from the source finding. Preserved exactly when present; null when absent.

devils_advocate.description: True when the finding is a devil's advocate counterpoint. Default false.

grounded_by.description: Array of grounding citations (URL strings or structured objects). Default empty array.

quality_profile.description: Finding quality profile marker. Modern findings use 'modern'; legacy findings carry null.

evidence.description: Modern finding evidence array. Empty for legacy findings.

runtime_evidence.description: Manifest-bound runtime evidence ingested from user-run Playwright JSON. Null when absent.

agreement.description: Agreement level string, e.g. 'unanimous', 'majority'. NOT coalesced from convergence. Null when absent.

reviewer_attribution.description: Array-form multi-model reviewer attribution. Null when absent or when only legacy string attribution exists; legacy strings land in reviewer_attribution_legacy_text.

fingerprint.description: Opaque fingerprint string used for wont-fix registry joins. NO post-hoc computation — null when absent in source.

improvement.description: Suggested improvement text. Null in pre-dev.41 shapes.

value.description: Raw value field. Historical reviews may use this as free-text Value justification; legacy-schema compatibility rules improvement metadata uses enum values high, medium, or low. Renderers must label enum values as improvement metadata and non-enum strings as value justification.

effort.description: legacy-schema compatibility rules improvement effort enum metadata, typically trivial, moderate, or invasive. Null when absent.

suggested_action.description: Suggested remediation action. Projected from `suggested_action` (priority) then `suggested_fix` (dev.55 era). Null when absent.

fix_status.description: Fix status from dev.10 era shapes only. Null in all other shapes.

decision.description: User-authored decision joined from decisions-<review_id>.json. Null when no decision has been captured for this finding.

calibration.description: Calibration join result. Null in Phase 0 — deferred per Sigil #4 (calibration_skipped_deferred warning).

resolution.description: Fix-log resolution joined when --fix-dir provided AND fix-log references this review_id. Includes per-finding `fix_outcome` from the matching changes_summary entry when available; top-level fix-log status remains lifecycle-only. Null otherwise.

wont_fix.description: Wont-fix registry match joined when --wont-fix provided AND fingerprint matches. Null otherwise.

fix_plan.description: Optional fix lifecycle plan joined from a matching fix log entry. This is proposal/planning metadata, not applied-change proof.

verification_cycle.description: Optional post-execution verifier outcome joined from a matching fix log entry.

agreement_count.description: Number of reviewers in agreement for this finding (multi-reviewer mode). Null in single-reviewer reviews and pre-schema-v2 corpus.

agreement_diversity.description: Whether the agreeing reviewers came from same provider ('same-provider') or distinct providers ('cross-provider'). Null when agreement_count is absent or when not applicable.

reviewer_attribution_legacy_text.description: Free-form string from the legacy 'convergence' or 'cross_reviewer_agreement' fields when the new array-form 'reviewer_attribution' is absent. Provides back-compat for pre-schema-v2 review logs. Null when array-form attribution is present.

line_anchors.description: Multi-line projection from source 'line_anchor' string (e.g., 'L138,L225' → [138, 225]). Single-line shapes project to a 1-element array. Null when source omits the field. Triggers field_dropped_unsupported_shape warning if any anchor token is unparseable.

f_id_display.description: Derived display pair for F-IDs. 'primary' is the canonical fnorm-normalized form (e.g. 'F1'); 'review_ref' preserves the original ref shape when it differs from primary (e.g. 'F-V1', 'F-A2'). When primary equals the original, review_ref is null and the renderer collapses to a single badge.

files_modified.description: Files mentioned in the joined fix-log's changes_summary entries that match this finding's id. Null when no fix-log join produces matches OR when no fix-dir was provided to the loader.

devils_advocate_signals.description: Structured array of devil's-advocate signals (pre-mortem, assumption-gap, inversion-risk, etc.) with kind+prose pairs. Distinct from the boolean devils_advocate flag — this is the rich-shape projection from schema-v2 multi-model reviews. Null when absent.

loader_warning.description: A single structured warning emitted by the loader during projection.

file.description: Path of the source review-log file that triggered this warning.

kind.description: Warning kind enum. See loader-warnings.md for full taxonomy.

detail.description: Human-readable description of the specific warning instance.
